exposure_history.outcome: The exposure achieved nothing it was intended to achieve. Making the repository public did NOT restore GitHub Actions. Runs were created on 642564b and 827fccd, but every job completed in under ten seconds with zero steps and no runner assigned — the same account-level failure that had produced startup_failure while the repository was private. The blocker is account-level and visibility-independent.
